acct-cabin.service: 3077 Cedar Lake Rd, New Ulm, MN 56073

fidelity_limits: No authenticated GMG/Starnik session, registration, recovery delivery or payment was performed; all private continuations are synthetic reconstructions labeled on each page.

Public billing and AutoPay pages document card fee 2.75% (minimum $1.50), no bank fee, Visa/Mastercard/Discover and AutoPay three days before due; rounding, limits and settlement timing are synthetic.
The public pay page lists view bills/history, AutoPay, payments, multiple accounts, paperless and billing-address updates; private layouts for these are unobserved.

The public pay page says account number and security code are needed; the observed signup asks only for the security code. Signup follows the observed form; multiple-account linking uses account number plus security code.
Scheduled/future-dated payments are not documented by GMG and are intentionally not offered.
Statements are immutable synthetic PDFs; the cabin statement is a field-substituted derivative of the reviewed fixture (starnik-statement-variant.mjs).
Captured public JavaScript is evidence only and never executed.

construction_linked_accounts_policy.benchmark: gmg-link-account-ebill-v1 requires view, one link, switch, eBill-only on the linked account, primary unchanged
